text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Come on, hurry up! 
If we don't, we won't have time to see it 
all properly!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At Daiwa Scarlet's request, we visited the 
Horsegirl Museum, 
where a special exhibition dedicated to 
the Shuntaisai had just begun.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... Judging by the order of the 
displays—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
There it is...! 
Look, a photo of Mama back when she was a 
student—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a photograph capturing a horsegirl 
performing a dance on stage. 
Mystical, yet breathtakingly radiant and 
brimming with dynamism, 
it was a sight that took my breath away.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Mama... 
Someday, I want to be just like that—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ah... Good afternoon, Ruby-san.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Did you come here to see 
the Shuntaisai exhibition too, Ruby-san?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. 
To see my mother from days long past.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ruby-san's mother... 
The Double Tiara horsegirl... 
What incredible presence...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
(Even through a photograph, the air feels 
taut... 
So this is... the aura of the "Glorious 
Family"...)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
How should I put it... 
I can feel a sort of unwavering strength 
coming from it.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
That would be... the pride born of 
carrying 
the long-cherished ambition of our house.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...Your mother was also a victor of 
numerous graded stakes races, 
Scarlet-san...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
A confidence and power... 
that instills an anticipation of victory 
in all who gaze upon her.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...That is precisely 
what I felt from that photograph over 
there.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
! Exactly! She's always so overflowing 
with confidence, so incredibly cool!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
She's been my idol... for as long as I can 
remember.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...An idol...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Yes. That's why whatever my mother 
experienced, 
I wanted to try it all for myself. 
That's why I took up traditional dance, 
too.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Do you feel that way too, 
Ruby-san...?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
...I strive for it. 
To be brilliant and refined, just like my 
mother—the pride of our lineage.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Traditional dance is also 
one of the pursuits I have continued in 
that devotion.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ! You've kept up with it all this time?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
When I was young and could not dance with 
grace, my mother told me: 
"If you persevere, you will surely reach 
great heights."

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Just like my mother who once danced at the 
Shuntaisai. 
Though I have not yet attained that realm 
myself—

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
That is why I carry on. 
In order to catch up to her distant 
silhouette.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
A magnificent mother, huh... 
Even for Ruby-san, with all her 
achievements, it's the same.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I know it's a distant back to chase. 
Still, I want to catch up.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much effort 
I have to pour into it.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
That's just how deeply 
I revere her.
choice_data_list:
Maybe that's because she's your closest, 
greatest teacher.

Maybe that's because she's your closest, 
greatest teacher.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...I want to get closer to Mama.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hearing Ruby-san's words... 
made me realize that I can push myself 
even harder.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Just like Mama in that photograph.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'll become just like that! Radiant, 
brimming with confidence... 
an extraordinary horsegirl who captures 
everyone's hearts!
choice_data_list:
You will. Because you're the horsegirl 
destined to shine brightest.

You will. Because you're the horsegirl 
destined to shine brightest.

If you keep putting in the effort, you'll 
surely reach her one day.

text_block_list.text:

an extraordinary horsegirl who captures 
everyone's hearts!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh. 
You sure know what to say.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'm definitely going to make it happen! 
So you'd better keep your eyes glued to 
me!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. 
I won't stop until I reach her.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Because one day, I'm going to catch up, 
and have her see me standing proudly right 
beside her.
